pages.title: Twilight Onet Connect
pages.creator: 2Million Games
pages.description: Twilight Onet Connect is a Halloween-themed tile-pairing puzzle. Look for two identical pictures and select them to make a match. Keep finding available partners among the spooky designs as you work toward clearing the board.

pages.title: Arrow Rescue
pages.creator: EmotGame
pages.description: Arrow Rescue asks you to free animals trapped inside a maze. Pull arrows in a useful order to remove barriers and open a safe route. Check that a move will not block the only remaining escape path.

pages.title: Fruit Match Juicy Puzzle
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Fruit Match Juicy Puzzle asks you to clear fruit by choosing useful matching combinations. Use mouse or touch input to select the fruit and work through each arrangement. Plan the next match around the pieces that will remain afterward.

pages.title: Grow a Garden: Online & Offline
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Grow A Garden: Online & Offline lets you buy seeds, raise plants, and sell the harvest. Start with a small plot and expand it with money from your crops. Check the seed shop as its stock refreshes and explore plants of different sizes.

pages.title: Goon Ball
pages.creator: CK's Games
pages.description: Goon Ball is a two-player contest to paint more of the floor before time expires. Hit the ball to spread your color and bump the opponent to stun them. Cover the larger area within ninety seconds to win.

pages.title: Cat Escape
pages.creator: Sunday GmbH
pages.description: Cat Escape is a stealth puzzle about guiding a cat to a green exit door. Sneak around guards and traps, hiding in closets or using disguises when needed. Buttons, portals, and special food provide different ways to open the route.

pages.title: Manyunya Saving the Princess
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description: Manyunya Saving The Princess follows a rescue quest through a world of knights and magic. Talk to characters, interact with the surroundings, and use the indicated buttons to handle encounters. Continue through the dangers while searching for the princess.

pages.title: Sneaker Art
pages.creator: TapNation
pages.description: Sneaker Art puts you in charge of designing and selling custom shoes. Paint the sneakers, choose laces, and combine the details into a finished design. Pack the completed shoes in boxes and display them in your shop to grow the business.

pages.title: Knots
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Knots is a hexagonal-tile puzzle about joining colored lines into complete knot patterns. Swap two pieces to connect matching ends, using the fixed gray tile as a guide. Follow one color at a time to work out the arrangement.

pages.title: Russian Checkers
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Russian Checkers lets you play against the computer, online opponents, or someone sharing the same screen. Move pieces diagonally and make compulsory captures, continuing a capture sequence when another is available. Kings can travel diagonally in either direction.

pages.title: Girl Rescue - Dragon Out
pages.creator: FunFox Games
pages.description: Girl Rescue - Dragon Out puts girls under threat from invading dragons. Use the cannons to stop the attackers before they can reach the characters. Plan the defense and react to the approaching dangers throughout each puzzle.

pages.title: Lovie Chic's Coachella Festival
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Lovie Chic's Coachella Festival lets you prepare a character's look for a music festival. Choose clothing, accessories, and makeup that fit the occasion. Mix the available pieces into a complete outfit before finishing the festival makeover.

pages.title: Car Escape
pages.creator: GameBox
pages.description: Car Escape is a sliding-vehicle puzzle about freeing a red fire truck. Move horizontal cars sideways and vertical cars up or down to clear its route. Open a path to the exit on the right side of the parking lot.

pages.title: Imposter 3D
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Imposter 3D is a character-based action game with different roles. Move close to an opponent to attack, or avoid enemy sight when playing as a hero. Position the character carefully around the other figures to complete the encounter.

pages.title: Air Block
pages.creator: RaselPlays
pages.description: Air Block makes limited block placement part of a platforming challenge. Jump, then place a block to create a useful foothold around enemies, saws, and spikes. Reach the doors in solo play or share the challenge with a second player.

pages.title: Drunk Man 3D
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Drunk Man 3D puts an unsteady ragdoll character into a difficult city route. Guide the movement carefully, since even a small collision can make the character stumble. Keep the balance under control while getting through the surroundings.

pages.title: Formula Racing Games Car Game
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Formula Racing Games Car Game puts you behind the wheel on Formula-style racing tracks. Steer through the course and work through its driving challenges. Learn the turns and control the car's speed as you pursue the finish.

pages.title: VSCO Girl Aesthetic
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: VSCO Girl Aesthetic lets you style Sunny, Skyler, Ruby, and Violet with a fashion theme. Browse each girl's wardrobe and choose suitable clothing for her look. Combine the available pieces to prepare the whole group.

pages.title: Sheep Sheep Duck
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Sheep Sheep Duck is a multiplayer party-fighting game with different battle settings. Move the character around the chosen scene and use attacks against opponents. Try to defeat more rivals while responding to the action around you.

pages.title: Home Pin 2
pages.creator: Gamee JSC
pages.description: Home Pin 2 combines pull-pin puzzles with a family's attempt to restore a manor. Remove bars in the right order to obtain supplies such as matches, charcoal, or gold. Protect the mother and daughter while unlocking rooms and household items.

pages.title: Toilet Monster Attack Sim 3D
pages.creator: SadaatGames
pages.description: Toilet Monster Attack Sim 3D puts you in a battle against unusual toilet and spider-train monsters. Move around the arena, look for the threats, and use the game's combat options to fight them. Work through the city-rescue encounters from first- or third-person views.

pages.title: BFFs Unique Halloween Costumes
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: BFFs Unique Halloween Costumes lets you help friends plan their Halloween outfits. Browse the costume choices and combine pieces into a distinct look for each character. Complete the group of designs before the friends show off their selections.

pages.title: Extreme Toy Race
pages.creator: Xenolia
pages.description: Extreme Toy Race offers racing for one or two players. Steer a toy vehicle through the course and compete to finish ahead. Use the respawn control when a mistake interrupts the drive and try the section again.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Online
pages.creator: Ringier Axel Springer Polska
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Online asks you to clear a field of colored bubbles with aimed shots. Connect at least three matching colors to remove them and open space for later shots. Keep the remaining bubbles from reaching the bottom line.

pages.title: Alien The Way Of Love
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Alien The Way Of Love lets you dress an alien couple for Valentine's Day in the city. Choose new clothing for both characters and combine the available pieces. Give the pair coordinated outfits for their time together.

pages.title: Mega Ramp Car Stunts
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Mega Ramp Car Stunts puts a car on high ramps and difficult stunt courses. Build speed for the next section, steer through the obstacles, and control the landing after jumps. Work through the route without losing the vehicle from the track.

pages.title: Color Quest Colors Game
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Color Quest Colors Game is a board-coloring puzzle with a limited number of moves. Change the arrangement until the entire screen becomes one color. Plan each choice so the remaining moves are enough to complete the level.

pages.title: River Adventure
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: River Adventure sends a canoe down a river filled with rocks and logs. Steer through the open water and keep the boat away from obstacles. Collect diamonds for more characters and complete missions while surviving the trip.

pages.title: Crowd Drift City
pages.creator: MOBASO
pages.description: Crowd Drift City makes you grow a gang of cars during a timed city run. Guide your vehicle toward other cars to collect them into the group. Build the biggest crowd and challenge rival gangs before the clock runs out.

pages.title: Snowboard Kings 2022
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Snowboard Kings 2022 challenges you to find a fast route down a snowy mountain. Avoid trees and rocks, manage icy sections, and escape the avalanche. Collect coins for skill upgrades and use the boost when extra speed helps.

pages.title: Impostor Shooter
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Impostor Shooter puts an armed character against spherical creatures of different colors. Aim at each target and fire before the next threat gets through. Shoot transparent balls containing coins to gather extra rewards during the fight.

pages.title: Animals Pic Tetriz
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Animals Pic Tetriz asks you to drop picture pieces into the correct places to rebuild animal images. Move each section over its destination and release it. Complete the arrangements across eight levels of this picture-based falling-block puzzle.

pages.title: Three Lines
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Three Lines tests your timing across blue, orange, and yellow tracks. Watch balls move down each line at different speeds and tap the corresponding target as one arrives. Keep handling all three tracks without letting too many balls pass.

pages.title: Sploop.io
pages.creator: LapaMauve
pages.description: Sploop.io combines resource gathering, village building, and player-versus-player combat. Collect materials, craft equipment, and place structures while defending against players or animals. Team up with friends when you want help developing the settlement and fighting rivals.

pages.title: Cube Pusher
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Cube Pusher makes you build up a push by holding the mouse button or screen. Release to launch the force and move objects toward the right positions. Adjust the amount of charge to handle the next cube arrangement.

pages.title: Sand Truck
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Sand Truck is a pin-pulling puzzle about delivering colored sand to matching trucks. Open the right pipes by removing pins in a useful order. Keep different colors on suitable routes so each load reaches the correct vehicle.

pages.title: The Hours
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: The Hours is a clock-reading game. Look at the requested time and choose the clock face that matches it. Compare the positions of the hour and minute hands before selecting an answer and continuing the activity.

pages.title: Love Proposal Coloring
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Love Proposal Coloring gives you romantic proposal-themed pictures to customize. Choose colors for the different items and fill the outlined artwork. Try matching shades or contrasting combinations to create your own version of the scene.

pages.title: Goldie Ruined Wedding
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Goldie Ruined Wedding asks you to restore a wedding damaged by a stepmother's spells. Repair the ballroom and cake, then choose an outfit for the bride. Try dresses and hairstyles to finish Goldie's renewed wedding preparations.

pages.title: Chaki Sky Jump
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Chaki Sky Jump follows a creature climbing a chain of platforms in the sky. Tap to guide it left or right and prepare for the next landing. Wait for horizontally moving platforms when needed so the jump does not end in a fall.

pages.title: Solitaire Tripeaks
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Solitaire Tripeaks combines card-clearing puzzles with an undersea theme. Select a card one rank above or below the current card to remove it from the layout. Keep finding usable values as you work through the different boards.

pages.title: Super Doll Sisters Transform
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Super Doll Sisters Transform lets you prepare a group of super-powered sisters for their next mission. Choose an outfit and hairstyle for Super Doll, then style her siblings. Coordinate the looks or give each sister a different design.

pages.title: Mega Levels Car Stunt Impossible Track Game
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Mega Levels Car Stunt Impossible Track Game puts you on elevated stunt routes with difficult driving sections. Control the car through ramps and obstacles while keeping it on the track. Work through the challenges to finish another course.

pages.title: GunGame 24 Pixel
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: GunGame 24 Pixel is a shooter with twenty-four guns and several combat modes. Fight computer-controlled soldiers or zombies, or join multiplayer matches with friends. Use the available equipment options to change camouflage and attachments while taking on the opposition.

pages.title: Space shooter Galaxy attack Galaxy shooter
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Space Shooter Galaxy Attack puts you in control of a fighter spacecraft. Choose a ship and move through the space battles while firing at the enemies ahead. Keep the craft clear of attacks to continue the arcade shooting run.

pages.title: Gimme Pipe
pages.creator: Game-Devs
pages.description: Gimme Pipe is a puzzle about repairing a broken sewer line. Connect the separate pieces into one long pipe by arranging their openings correctly. Study how the bends fit together before committing the next section.

pages.title: PixelForces.io
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: PixelForces.io is an online shooter set in vertical, maze-like maps with trampolines. Jump between routes and fight other players using the selected match mode. Customize the character and create a room or join an existing battle.

pages.title: Animal Origami Coloring
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Animal Origami Coloring offers eight pictures of folded-paper animals to color. Choose from twenty-three shades and fill the outlined designs with your own combinations. Save a picture when finished and try another animal or a different palette.

pages.title: Anime Girl With Gun Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Anime Girl With Gun Puzzle provides six illustrated character pictures as jigsaw challenges. Select a piece count between sixteen and one hundred and drag the sections into place. Match the picture's details until the entire illustration is restored.

pages.title: Torture The Trollface
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Torture The Trollface gives you a cartoon dummy and a collection of destructive tools. Try different attacks, collect coins, and unlock more equipment such as traps or toy-like weapons. Experiment with the available options in the character-damage activity.

pages.title: Box Adventure
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Box Adventure follows a small box searching for its father after an abduction by a spaceship. Guide it through the adventure's route with keyboard or touch controls. Work through the challenges while continuing the search for the missing parent.

pages.title: Sunset Driver
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Sunset Driver puts your car on a road with oncoming vehicles to avoid. Steer into clear space and collect diamonds during the drive. Use the diamonds to buy different vehicle skins as you try to extend the run.

pages.title: Toy Box Blast!
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Toy Box Blast! is a colored-block puzzle about clearing groups from a board. Choose matching boxes to remove them and work toward the level's collection targets. Special pieces can clear rows, columns, or larger areas when the arrangement becomes difficult.

pages.title: Word Splice
pages.creator: Arwin Margallo
pages.description: Word Splice turns broken word fragments into a letter-combining puzzle. Tap circles in an order that forms a complete word and removes them from the level. Tap a selected circle again when you need to revise the combination.

pages.title: BTS Lion Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: BTS Lion Coloring Book gives you lion pictures to fill with chosen colors. Select a page and apply shades to its outlined sections. Try different palettes to create your own version of the animal artwork.

pages.title: A1 Citycarver 2020 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: A1 Citycarver 2020 Puzzle offers six car images to assemble. Choose sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four, or one hundred pieces, then place the sections in their correct positions. Complete the vehicle picture before trying another image or difficulty.

pages.title: Water Slide Cars
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Water Slide Cars puts cars into races on water-slide-style tracks. Steer through the route, keep control of the bends, and compete against the other vehicles. Choose among different cars while working through the available levels.

pages.title: Cartoon Bear Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Cartoon Bear Puzzle asks you to rebuild an illustrated bear picture from scattered parts. Drag each piece back to its original place and match neighboring edges. Keep assembling the sections until the complete animal scene is restored.

pages.title: Left Turn Otto The Otter Side
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Left Turn Otto The Otter Side challenges you to get an otter home using mostly left turns. Tap to start moving and tap again to turn. Beach balls and mix-up markers change how Otto travels through fifty-six levels.

pages.title: Hanuman Adventure
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Hanuman Adventure is a platform journey inspired by Hanuman's search for Sita in the Ramayana. Run and jump through the route, using attacks against the enemies ahead. Work through the challenges as the quest continues toward Lanka.

pages.title: Mommy Accident ER
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Mommy Accident ER is a fictional emergency-care activity after a character falls at home. Check her pulse and use the available tools to treat her wounds. Follow the on-screen appointment through its different care steps.

pages.title: Fruit Match
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fruit Match is a fruit-selection puzzle built around collecting matching pieces. Swipe to choose fruit groups and clear them from the board. Build enough points to meet the target score and continue through the levels.

pages.title: Stick Golf
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Stick Golf asks you to set a shot's direction and club power to reach the hole. Judge the terrain and avoid bunkers or water hazards. Try to finish each course with fewer strokes as the layouts become more challenging.

pages.title: Battle On Road
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Battle On Road puts an armed car into road combat with enemies. Direct your attacks toward the opposing vehicles and other threats while the battle continues. Earn rewards from defeated enemies and use them to buy additional cars.

pages.title: Mini Racer
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Mini Racer offers two racing activities with a selection of vehicles. Choose a car and compete against computer-controlled opponents. Steer through the cartoon courses while trying to improve your position in the race.

pages.title: Visit To The Mall
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Visit To The Mall follows a group of girls through a shopping trip. Browse the mall's different stores and help select fashion clothing or accessories. Combine the purchases into new looks for the characters.

pages.title: Dangerous Racing
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Dangerous Racing is a lap-based driving challenge against an unpredictable opponent. Watch for the rival car changing into your lane without warning and move out of its path. Complete more laps while avoiding a collision.

pages.title: Fidget Spinner.io
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Fidget Spinner.io puts a controllable spinner in an arena of energy pickups. Move around the map and absorb points to become stronger. Keep gathering energy while navigating the space shared with the other spinners.

pages.title: Offroad Racer
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Offroad Racer sends you onto a mountain track against computer-controlled cars. Steer through the rough route and manage the bends while competing for position. Keep the vehicle under control as you work toward the finish.

pages.title: GunBattle
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: GunBattle is a battle-royale shooter about being the last player remaining. Move through the arena, fire at opponents, and stay clear of their attacks. Keep surviving the fights until the other competitors have been eliminated.

pages.title: Baby Fun Day
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Baby Fun Day lets you spend time caring for baby versions of Elsa and Anna. Join their play activities and respond to the care tasks shown on screen. Help both characters through the day's interactive routine.

pages.title: Instagirls Dress Up
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Instagirls Dress Up combines outfit selection with a social-photo activity. Choose a girl, dress her, and take a picture for an in-game Instagram post. Complete hashtag challenges to earn likes that can be spent on more clothes.

pages.title: TicTec Shot
pages.creator: Solstice Games
pages.description: TicTec Shot is a space shooter with a controllable jet and attacking enemy formations. Move clear of their projectiles and return fire to eliminate them. Use the weapons and pickups available during the fight to continue through the waves.

pages.title: Jewel Hunt
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Jewel Hunt is a match-three puzzle with forty levels and an endless option. Make matching jewel combinations to clear pieces and work through the boards. Use consecutive combinations for bonus scoring in the ongoing mode.

pages.title: Princesses Winter Refreshment
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Princesses Winter Refreshment lets you update Elsa and Belle's wardrobes for winter. Start with new outfits, choose shoes, and complete the remaining styling details. Combine the seasonal pieces into fresh looks for both princesses.

pages.title: Freedom Fish
pages.creator: Playcombo
pages.description: Freedom Fish follows a fish trapped in packaging after escaping a pet store. Remove blocks and interact with objects to move it toward the sea. Keep the fish away from crabs, jellyfish, and sharp shells along the route.

pages.title: Trip to Japan
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Trip To Japan lets you dress Lina for activities on her holiday. Explore clothing inspired by traditional Japanese fashion, including patterned yukata. Combine the available pieces into an outfit for the next part of her trip.

pages.title: Nails Makeover
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Nails Makeover puts you in charge of a salon visit for princesses. Choose nail colors and decorative patterns for each character. Mix the available designs to finish a manicure that matches the princess's preferred look.

pages.title: MindCoach - Towers
pages.creator: Mariusz Obajtek
pages.description: MindCoach - Towers asks you to place tower heights so each value appears once per row and column. Edge clues show how many towers should be visible from that direction, with taller ones hiding shorter ones. Click a field to increase its height and satisfy every clue.

pages.title: Princess Summer Tans
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Princess Summer Tans follows four friends preparing for a beach trip. Work through grooming and body-care activities, then choose bikinis for their holiday. Complete the makeover steps to get the group ready for the summer getaway.
